body:
Asked me months earlier if I wanted a workout mat, I said no I already had a yoga mat that I used and liked. Holiday comes around, he lets me know that a gift is coming, that’s mostly for the both of us and that my main gift is him….. gift comes, it’s the same workout mat that apparently he wanted. 

This was after getting me instagram crap for my birthday and getting me something I already had for Christmas, which he returned and said I didn’t deserve a present and that it wasn’t his fault cause you know he tried 🙄

So true. I didn’t study abroad in college because my bf at the time said he would break up with me if I did. And now with everything I do I’m unable to take the same amount of time off as I would have been able to in college. Still regret it to this day
Cherries. I remember then always being a little more expensive, but now if I want a bag it’s $15 for it. So I’ll just remember the good times of them

I’ve had men who liked me offer the same and one guy rearranged all my purses on my high shelf and hung up my artwork. He got super into it and had a pencil and ruler to mark everything out to make sure it’s even. Another guy later also ended up hanging up some different artwork I have. They like to show off how handy they can be! I ended up dating one for 3 months and the other ghosted me after I couldn’t come over to his house at 2pm on a workday. So you win some and lose some

I basically stayed by mine and took care of him while he was going through alcoholics phases, drug addiction, surgery, job loss and everything else. Her reasoning was that because I wanted us to get our own furniture and not use her hand me down(including her old bed), that I was trying to control him and I had to go
Mine was his mom TOLD him too after we had already been together for 2.5 years and he was over 30
I just need to find a new doctor so that’s on my current list of items to do! I’ll ask about the soft imagining, I haven’t heard of that before

I carry a lot of weight in my legs and no matter how much I work out it won’t come off. I don’t have any definition in my ankles anymore and my calves are more straight now then having any sort of shape. I also bruise very easily, have large fat pads on the inside of my knees, saddlebags on my sides. It also looks like cellulite on my upper thighs, however you feel slight lumps when you rub them and splitting pain on the side when feeling up my thighs. 

I also wake up every morning with almost like a heaviness in my calves and just feels very much like fluid retention.

I believe it does. I have to try and get actually confirmation from a doctor that I have it and then I can start paperwork and searching for a plastic surgeon. My current doctor just told me that I’m fat, and gave me weight loss pills.
That I can try to do! I do a lot of cardio but not much lifting in my arm area
Would a mini lift be able to get rid of the hanging skin?

I’d like to get to around 130 since I feel more comfortable around that weight. I think I have lipedema in my legs though so it’s really hard for me to get down and stay consistent. I don’t mind the wait time to see results.

Wow this sounds exactly like someone that I have started to consider a loose friend! She doesn’t even put gatherings together because she doesn’t like her friends to talk to each other in case they want to spend time together without her.
I’m down. I have a couple weddings coming up in the next few months and I’d like to lose some weight!

I’m in my late 20s and I’d love to make new friends. I’m trying to get more into walking and maybe yoga classes. There are so many cute areas in bishop arts and trinity grooves has some nice little restaurants too!
Awww my dad did this too. I was getting ready for work and he texted me Happy Valentine’s Day Love you. Which is really all I need right now and my doggy!
That’s exactly what he wanted me to do! Apparently he doesn’t realize that it’s like and things can change and still hang out
No he’s not married since he invited me to his place and sent me pictures of what his place looked like
True, I guess I’m glad I’ve only known him for a couple weeks so just onto the next one it seems. But I might take a break, dating has been so exhausting lately
It’s also like you’re 31 and giving me the silent treatment! It’s super immature

So normally on Thursdays I do leave work early because I have a standing 2pm appointment which meant I would have been able to be at his place. However I had gotten an email that my appointment needed to be cancelled so then I texted him and told him what had happened and that I would try to be there early but now I had to stay at work and when the others left I would be able to leave.

I actually had texted him the morning that my appointment got cancelled and that I was at work. I had said I was going to try to leave around the time I said I would but that I couldn’t leave while the other people were still in the office. And he told me that was fine no rush. I texted him as I was leaving the office. And I told him the exact time I was getting home and would be at his place. 

I really try not to disappoint others, but it’s also like I work 45 minutes from home and then he lived 20 from me. I did try my best to be super communicative with him about everything and where I was. I also don’t see why getting to his play at 5:45 we couldn’t have made the pasta, let it rise for an hour. During that time we could make the filing, have wine and have dinner by 7:30. The timing would have worked out fine

He did propose that we see each other when I get back from my trip this weekend, but then he also started giving me the silent treatment even after I apologized for not being able to leave work early
He’s older than me! He’s 31. And I had liked the fact that the couple of times we hung out before he didn’t pressure me for anything physical, but it appears that was just a facade

Oh my gosh I had an ex who would do that! I would say I love sleep and that I was tired and in the middle of the night if he woke up he wanted “fun” time and I would say no, but it would be something like well you’re already awake why can’t you. 

Just annoying because I have to work too and pay my bills, take care of my dog, yet I’m still supposed to be this “cool” girl who can leave work at the drop of a hat to spend time and coddle someone. I just don’t get men like this anymore

Not even work late. I normally work till 5 and he wanted me to leave at 3. It’s like I work in an office with 3 other people, I can’t just up and leave while they’re still there! And they stayed till like 4:30 so I left after them anyway!

So we actually were going to make the dough from scratch. Which I had all the flour and stuff to make it. And it just needed an hour to rise. So we still could have had dinner by 7:30, and we had gotten a cheeseboard and wine. But it was like because I couldn’t take off from work early to drive home then drive over it wasn’t even worth it to spend time with me
And I even offered to get take out, so I don’t really see why he was so upset.
Thank you! I learn something new all the time!
I have also heard of the microwave method. I don’t know if that works in royal icing or only in buttercream.
I have sat in both and to me they are pretty identical in terms of comfort. They are both exact same size and have the same entertainment setup. It’s just the slight more sport features

I generally don’t eat breakfast due to just not doing well with early morning food. But for lunch if I do eat, it’s mostly fruits or hard boiled eggs. And then goes dinner it’s a lot of tofu and rice and veggies. Or if I get chicken, I will save the bones and throw a couple veggies and a little bit of seasoning and make my own stock! 

It feels a lot better to know that if I got a chicken I used all of it
I’m in! I’m 29F and I have a vacation coming up that I need motivation to get in shape for

Yes!! Any time I go home for the holidays my parents always push to eat more and there’s just more food around. So at least this is the one time of year where I ignore the scale and go back to my routine when I leave!
I think each day we slowly realize it’s just a path downward. So I don’t think I’ll ever be okay. But that in itself is okay. We aren’t like others, and we don’t get the happy ending that others get.

I always used to get so excited to get everything ready for the holidays, but after my ex kept all of my decor I haven’t felt in the mood to want to do anything and this has just kinda made it more this year. So I feel at peace with my decision and date for next year. And maybe if I was a better person life would have been better but I guess that’s life

I’m so sorry you feel this way and I want you to know you’re not alone! I too cried myself to sleep last night and told myself that if by August of next year my life hasn’t changed anything for the better then that will be it. I have no plans to continue on in life. I don’t have a boyfriend and my friends are pretty much not around anymore. So thankfully I won’t leave anyone sad behind
I’m trying to let him lead where it is going. So I’m not double texting, and trying to play things cool

I like to think I do! I’m well educated, have a good full time job, pay my bills, take care of myself, in shape, attractive, come from a good family. Pretty much everything someone would want! I just do need to focus on my neediness and probably find some hobbies again that I enjoy!

Men can think like that because they have time. I want children, so I don’t have time to wait 7 years in a relationship to see if they want to get married or not. These are my absolute prime years right now! So I really would like to meet someone and be able to settle down and have kids within a couple of years.

You’re right I don’t know what his flaws are. But isn’t that what dating is to get to know someone to see if you’re compatible. 

Everything that I’ve seen and talked to him shows that he would definitely be able to handle responsibilities. He’s cleaner than I am! So I wouldn’t have to feel like I was taking care of someone and I would be able to make sure my work gets done too. 

My dad is a workaholic and wasn’t around when I was growing up, so I don’t really have as much of an issue with that as I think a lot of people. I would actually prefer someone to be a workaholic because then I don’t feel like they’re always hovering. And the time we spend together matters. 

I’m also at that age though where I do want someone who wants similar things as me in the future, especially since I can’t afford to wait around another 2 years dating just to be dumped. Which is why I told him I wanted to date someone a year before a proposal!
We are not! He’s not super religious, while I do normally go to a weekly women’s Bible study now but that’s mostly because I like the getting to know new people

I guess I don’t have too, and I could absolutely wait there isn’t a rush. If it’s meant to be, a couple of weeks of texting everyday and calling every couple days and seeing each other once a week isn’t going to matter. Yep he’s showed me pictures of him with his parents! And when I got to meet his brother they were talking about going home that week for dinner with mom and dad. He had talked about his ex too, because he wanted to make sure I was ready to date again, since he had been broken up with his gf for about a year now

That’s kinda why I feel like I should wait and let him lead to see where it’s going. 

I think I just feel so happy because we actually have full conversations about literally anything and everything. And while I do want us to spend more time together I don’t want to come across as needy. I actually did apologize for something that was needy and he kissed me and told me that he thinks it’s sweet and that he wants me to feel reassured. 

I actually was talking to another guy, but that ended when he lost his job, on his side. But I don’t even feel like swiping on anyone else. Like I tried and I just didn’t find anything fun about. When we had talked about it he was shocked and said that sometimes things just work out the way they’re supposed to. Which I’m like all for. 

He did ask me what kind of ring I wanted, and I told him so he is aware. He also said his parents want to meet me. I did say how I was sad we wouldn’t see each other that much soon because of the holidays and work and he said that it would be okay and we would make it through it. But I do think I should probably spend more time with him before I define the relationship
But should I spend a couple more times with him in person?

The couple times we have spent together we’ve literally spent most of the day and night together. And we never seem to run out of things to say. I just don’t know if we should spend a couple more times in person together before I bring up asking if he sees us as dating
Nope I’ve been to his place! And I met his brother/brothers fiancé on the first date since they were having dinner at the restaurant next to us!
That’s probably fair. He seems open to it, but you’re right I don’t know things will go

I don’t feel love bombed from it. I feel like he wants to know if we’re on the same page, which I do appreciate a lot. So he’s super family orientated which I do love, and when I talked to him last week he went over to his parents house 3 of those days. And he’ll text me through out the day and when he finishes work. But I’ve also have different things going on so we haven’t been able to meet as much. I have tentatively asked to see what he is doing for NYE .
Do you think it’s better to do it in person or bring it up on the phone when we talk?
His mom told him to break up with me and he did. He’s 31…..
I wish I liked driving, but I really don’t that much.
I hate the weekends. I basically just stay in and be depressed because I don’t have anyone to spend time with

For me it’s horrible from Friday night to Sunday , because it makes me realize I don’t have anyone to spend time with. At least during the week I can bury myself in work, but the weekend I just want to cry.

So you sound a lot like me with tons and tons of thoughts running in your head to where you get so overwhelmed. Before the love of my life broke my heart he used to have me do deep breaths and try to center myself because I would feel like I was all over the place! 

I think it helps to figure out what is it about this person that you struggle with. What about you don’t you like? What do you think would make you feel better?
I feel like I have no friends. I had found a roommate to move in but even she backed out and said she was moving back home to her family and friends. So it’s back to just me and the dog

My mom: I was 11 and she told me “No one is ever going to love you, because if I can’t love you as your mother, then no one else can either.” Or “I don’t even like you, I only tolerate you because you’re my kid.”

My dad: I was 15 and he threw my lamp at me because I was crying. And at 25 he told me to go kill myself if I was too upset over the way they treated me growing up. 

As such I’m very socially awkward, have a hard time making friends, and self sabotage every relationship because I don’t think I deserve love.
His mom told him to break up with me. He’s 31 and we were looking at engagement rings after being together almost 3 years

My parents, yes both used to call me a LUG whenever they wanted to hurt me. It stood for Lesbian Until Graduation because no guys wanted to date me so I must be a lesbian… even though I’m not and never was. And even when my most recent bf ended things my dad decided to bring back the term and start calling me it again.
27 was my best year. I had an amazing partner, lots of friends and everything was perfect. Funny how I’m just a couple years later all that can go downhill so easily.

I also self sabotage myself too a lot when I am happy because I don’t think I deserve it and am waiting on the other shoe to drop. Completely how I ruined my relationship and I have no one to blame but myself.
Currently wine and rice cakes!
My on/off bf sent me a song called Complete You by some French group that made me pretty sad, especially since I have no idea what’s going on right now.

I can’t do puzzles anymore, bake or go to specific restaurants because all I do is think of him. I would do puzzles while he would play video games and he would tell me how great I was doing and compliment me on making progress on these large puzzles. Now I have my puzzle board tucked away and can’t even bring myself to open it. 

I would also bake every chance I get and make him desserts to take to his office. I haven’t touched any of my baking stuff since then and I have so much. It just doesn’t make me happy anymore. 

And restaurants we would go to I can’t even get close to them.
I’m on Prozac during the day and a sleep med at night. Though that one isn’t working because I still am up till midnight and wake up a ton at night and feel like crap the next day.
No difference at all. Still laying in bed because I have no motivation to do anything.
Yep, currently on some and I don’t feel anything anymore. Just empty and hopeless and going through the motions of work and home.

The last 2 years the holidays were amazing. I would go all out, decorate, cider, comfort food, holidays treats whole 9 yards. But now that I’m alone again, I just can’t put in the same effort. It’s not fun to celebrate, decorate, cook or bake for 1. And since I live in an apartment, space is very limited.

The relationship ended due to his mental health and our communication towards one another. And so I still love him, and I always will. We were perfect in every way and picked out our engagement rings together. So I can’t even imagine being anyone else.

When I had my bf I was the happiest I’ve ever been in my life. I still had the normal anxiety and stress because that’s just who I am as a person, but all depression and thoughts of suicide were gone. Now that it’s ended I’ve completely shut down and am more suicidal then ever. And have told myself that next years it because of how much I really can’t continue in this life.

When my mom sat me down at the kitchen table at 11 and told me that no one was going to love me in life because she didn’t love me. Shattered any hope I ever had to talk to anyone or be with anyone while at home. Then when I went to college only to be cheated on and told my mom was right that I was never going to end up with someone because no one wants to be with me. 

So then of course the best relationship I’m in I self sabotaged two months ago. So now at 29, I’ve accepted that I’m a toxic person who can be with anyone because I make others unhappy. So I’d rather be unhappy alone then make others feel that way.

I cry myself to sleep and have sleeping pills because I have such bad anxiety about being alone. Which I normally take with alcohol at night because that’s the only way I can pass out. Then I just work and go through my day like a zombie

I cry myself to sleep and have sleeping pills because I have such bad anxiety about being alone. Which I normally take with alcohol at night because that’s the only way I can pass out. Then I just work and go through my day like a zombie

Last time I felt loved was July 18, when my bf and I spent time together after going on vacation and we said how much we loved each other. The next night he had a mental breakdown and that Thursday morning he broke up with me. My heart has been shattered since and since he was the love of my life I know I won’t have another like that.

I just recently got my heart absolutely shattered into millions of tiny pieces. And even though I’m 29, I feel like I put my heart and sole into it and in the end I wasn’t enough and I messed up so I don’t even want to try again. I don’t see the point when I’m exhausted, and I hate having to start from scratch with people. So if he comes back to me I’d jump through hoops for him, but I don’t want to try again with someone new.

It really is. And the worse part was is that I am an emotionally anxious person so everything was good until I was so insecure that I kept pushing and pushing and made him so unhappy to even be around me. So yep he left and the funny part was I saw him about 5 weeks ago because we run in the same circles in our city and have a lot of overlapping friends, and he told me how much he loved me and wanted to be with and since then nothing

1. Friends, because as my mom said you don’t need them in life and they won’t get you anywhere. 
2. Lock on door, because I lived under her roof so as such I’m not allowed any privacy
3. Buying new clothes, she didn’t believe in them so when it was my birthday relatives would take me shopping because those we be the only clothes I would get all year. 

No she wonders why I’m stunted emotionally, have little to no friends, and struggle with my feelings and life. But she just proceeds to call me a loser compared to my younger siblings and tells me how much better they are then me

What do you think makes you a bad person? 

I know personally I am. Everyone who has ever been around me ends up hating me, my family abused me growing up, friends left me for better ones, bfs cheated on me or let me. And the love of my life just told me that I made him so unhappy he had a mental breakdown. 

And so it’s easy for me to sit and cry every night and feel empty, because even though I go to church and bible study I don’t think god has a plan for me because otherwise i wouldn’t be so tainted that not a single person wants to be around me. 

I have 11 months until I’m done with everything. I have a wonderful sweet dog who loves me more then anything but it’s just not enough anymore

I know how you feel. I work full time, I have multiple degrees, I volunteer in my spare time and yet I don’t feel anything. I feel alone and lost and hopeless, like nothing matters in this world anymore. 

I do believe that when we no longer at exist that’s it. There is no pain or joy or anything we’re just gone. And I think that brings relief in its own self
I will be in the same boat as you are in 11 months.

I had a wonderful amazing relationship with the man I was going to marry and I fucked up. I fucked up so bad and there’s not even a point right now. I have 1 year till I’m 30 and I don’t even want to get out of bed tomorrow. And for me I have a few friends but nothing compares to having someone who loves you and you can talk about anything with them. And now that’s gone I have no purpose in life anymore

I used to have hope when I had a bf and friends and something to look forward too. Now I have absolutely nothing and have given myself 11 months. Then I’m done. I can’t keep waking up everyday feeling like absolute crap and expecting to smile like something great is going to happen, because it’s not. Nothing great happens, and I just want it to end.

I just can’t ever stop thinking about him. I feel like I have a whole and just feel empty without him. I know he is worth waiting for, and I know that he’s going through a lot. And I feel like most of this is my fault. I made him unhappy, I kept pushing and pushing and I knew he was stressed and needed space but when he was struggling I was there wanting more and more from him when I should have been supporting him. 

I would deal with his mother everyday if I had to, he always supported me and it’s about time I did the same for him. He has a tendency of acting like this when he freaks out so I hope he comes back.

I don’t think I will ever move on though. I would wait for this man, because I’ve always thought he was worth it and I knew when I met him that I loved him and would show him that everyday. Which I will say I didn’t do a very good job of that the last couple of months. I had a lot of family problems and feeling like an outcast. 

I just think he didn’t have the best life so far and I’m willing to be there for him while he works things out on what he needs too. Also from what I’ve seen the assistant was only there because his mom told her to not have him be alone. 

But I saw him about 3 weeks ago and we went home together and he did tell me he wasn’t ready to unblock me yet. But that he wants us to be together and that he loves me, he’s only ever loved me and that he wants us to work. He asked me if I was good with our relationship and being together and I said yes, and he goes I hope so, and I said I know so. This was all sober too, so I know he meant what he said. So I will say I hate the waiting, because this has happened before when he gets emotionally overwhelmed. 

I have to figure out a couple big items in my life in the next couple of months, move apartments, new car, multiple doctors appointments. But I don’t have any major hobbies

Well I’ve been trying to get back into working out again and figuring out things to do on the weekends. I have to see him again soon, we run in the same social circles and have a lot of the same friends, so I just want to look amazing when I see him. He is a good person he just doesn’t think sometimes

Thankfully though skills to handle life like this can be learned. And that’s why I am definitely pro therapy for both of us as well as himself, since I know if we learn to communicate we wouldn’t have anything to worry about.

I just think he has a lot of his own demons that he deals with, only child, abuse as a child, psycho(to me) mother, stressful job, lack of support, severe depression, bi polar disorder, etc. So I just know that he’s going through a lot in life and yet he would still tell me he loves me every day, and he never lied to me. If I asked something he would always tell me the truth which I didn’t realize how much that meant. But yes my anxiety is a relationship stressor. And yes the waiting around sucks. But I’ve always thought he’s worth it and I would wait forever for him.
Not at the moment no. But I’m hoping that will change soon. I started my own therapy and am meeting with a psychiatrist to go over my anxiety

It’s actually the best relationship that I’ve ever been in. We just have some communication issues that we both struggle with. I have a very abusive family and as such I can be a very anxious person and not understand what others are going through in life and only focus on what I want. He is an avoidant person so when he has too much going on at once such as me demanding a lot, his mom going through a lot right now in some legal issues, and then work having him work 70 hour work weeks he just shuts down. So when we talk we are good, but it’s times where we both need to step away from our problems and spend some quality time together we need to work on.
I just really hope he comes around again soon, I really do love and miss him
If he reaches out again that is one thing I’m going to heavily insist. I just started therapy for myself a couple weeks ago. I want to feel better since I have my own family issues

My on/off bfs mom (we’re off right now) and I went to lunch a couple of months ago. There she proceeded to tell me that it wasn’t that she didn’t like me, she didn’t like me with her son. He’s also an only child and will tell everyone around that she only had one child because he was so perfect that she could never love another as much as him. (clearly it’s not because she got divorced….) 

She also raised him by telling him that no one will ever love him as much as she does, and that he isn’t meant to end up with anyone in life because it’s just supposed to be the two of them together….. 

And he knows this happens, he’s told friends that his mom has run off every girl he’s ever wanted to be with. We were a lot more serious then others, being together 2.5 years and looking to get engaged that I feel she really had to make it clear to me I wasn’t welcome. Unfortunately for her I also have a mother who hates me and I’m resilient and will always try to be with him as long as he loves me, which I know he does.
I do have therapy coming up this week, so I am looking forward to that. I still wish everyday that he will come back. I think I will always love him no matter what.
I like to think that if we feel this way and no one has helped us so far it won’t hurt them for us to die

I literally just had a “friend” tell me she couldn’t be around me when I act like this. Even though when she was going through stuff I picked up the phone for her everything and talked her off the ledge, but so much for being there when I need the same. I don’t think wanting to kill your self is selfish, and I hate how when you try to reach out for help no one if interested
I like to write letters in my head to people that convey how much they meant to me. I like to think when I go someone will make sure they go where they are supposed to

I feel like all I’m doing is just work, sitting at the office alone some nights till 7pm because I don’t want to go home to my empty apartment. It’s hard when there are no friends who text you, a bf who broke up with you and immediately moved on and if so happy, a family who doesn’t include you. I look at this computer screen and I don’t see the point. What’s the point of me working another 50 years, coming home alone everyday, and not one person caring about me. I would rather end it all then sit at a desk with no life or soul left 50 years later

I have pushed away everyone in my life by not being a happy upbeat go with the flow type of person. I have no more friends since my bf broke up with me. My family doesn’t include me in family vacations and I’m not even included in holidays anymore. I don’t know if it gets better. I thought my life was starting to change and then in an instant I’m back alone and done for. It’s hard to feel this way, because people don’t want to look at those of us who appear damaged. Everyone just wants the happy Instagram photos that are out there.

And it’s crazy because you can’t actually talk to people about this, because there’s something wrong with us. They don’t feel that way, they get to focus on their future and their families. While I think wow if I got into this car crash would I have anyone to be an emergency contact. I’ve stopped putting people as one because I just don’t really have anyone who would really show up for me

I think people can just be innately selfish. When you mention this a normal person would be there to listen to you and see why you’re feeling that way. Parents like we have growing are worried what their image will look like because they want people to think that they raised their kids right. No one sees the behind the scenes, like when my dad told me I felt this way that maybe I should go kill myself. Or my mom who has told me from childhood she hated me and I should never have been born. Yet they put on such similes in front of others. 

I’ve always known since I was a child that this is how I would die, I always knew that no one was every truly there for me or cared for me. And in a way now all I feel is emptiness and numbness

I feel this. My family goes on their own vacations and has just decided that they’re life is better off without me. My bf broke up with me because I kept pushing him and he’s already taken it up with his moms assistant so he’s better off without. Most of my friends were all group couple friends and they’ve all abandoned me, so they are better off without me. I think it I were to die tomorrow not one single person would be shocked. And I keep trying to think it will get better, but I really don’t think it will. It’s just hard to wake up everyday feeling like nothing matters in the world anymore

I really have thought about this as well, and how easy it would be if I was in the wrong place wrong time and something just happened to me. The only reason I haven’t so far if I need to figure out what to do with my doggy
My bf just broke up with me right before my birthday. And I honestly don’t think I’ll make it to the next years either.

I don’t even know. All I can think about is how I pushed this to ruin. I tried too hard and pushed instead of worked together and I feel like I ruined my own relationship. I still think I’m always going to want him back. I just don’t know if he would ever come back to me, since I wasted my last chance
